keep_playing_why: In A I was shooting, scoring and seeing the grey valley turn to colour within the first minute, and every few seconds something paid off with a big number or a Bloom burst. B asked me to wait, read and turn a mirror with two thumbs for minutes for a tiny icon. A had a rough first 30 seconds, but B never got fast enough to hold me.
better_made_why: B looks like a finished game: clean rooms, a real character, clear prompts for each new verb, and no moment where I could not tell what hurt me. A has the better feedback and the lovely sketch-to-colour look, but it left me dying to attackers I could not see and the damage cue was hard to read. B's 15 s load and unclear mirror aiming are real faults, so it is close.
furthest_A: Broke the first inkwell (Olive Terraces, 1 of 5) at about 322 s, picked Arc lens, walked into Millbrook village and reached the second inkwell once (died there). About 5.5% of the valley restored, score about 130,000, died roughly 12 times.
furthest_B: Level 1, The Sunken Court: read the field notes, pushed the stone block, lit stelae 1 and 3 of 3 (two of three glyphs), never opened the gate. Levels 2 to 4 shown as locked.
